protocol_deviations_and_failures.detail: The bounded write-enabled workflow rendered 300 observations, materialized the generated registry commit, passed repository validators, the pass-48 Explicit Edit admission check, and the existing live admission path.

GitHub did not automatically execute the workflow for the bot-authored generated-registry commit; this was superseded by explicit restoration of the standard read-only workflow and a fresh validation.
